dossier_meta.statement_text: For every integer $t\geq 2$ we have $h(t)=\left\lceil\frac{3}{2}(t-1)\right\rceil$. In other words, if a hypergraph $H$ does not contain $K_{t}$ as a minor, then $\chi(H)\leq\left\lceil\frac{3}{2}(t-1)\right\rceil$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The function $h(t)$ is the smallest integer such that every $K_t$-minor-free hypergraph is $h(t)$-colorable. The paper proves the lower bound $h(t)\geq\left\lceil\frac{3}{2}(t-1)\right\rceil$ by an explicit construction, and conjectures this lower bound is tight. The conjecture remains open even for $t=3$, where the best known upper bound is $4$.
